You have attempted this same task before and did not succeed. These are the plans you wrote after those attempts.
Trial #1: New plan: I failed to update the graph correctly after revisiting rooms, specifically leaving the "edges" dictionary empty even when moving between known rooms (e.g., moving from Balcony to Nursery should have added an edge, but I only updated the nodes list). I also failed to track which rooms had been fully explored to determine when to stop. Next time, I will strictly update the "edges" dictionary for every move, adding the connection between the current room and the previous room (or the room being entered) in the correct direction, and I will maintain a mental or explicit list of visited rooms to ensure I only stop when no unvisited neighbors remain.

New plan: I failed to correctly update the "edges" dictionary when revisiting rooms, specifically omitting the edge in the direction of the room I was leaving (e.g., when moving from Balcony to Nursery, I did not add an entry for "north" in the Balcony's edges, even though the graph showed the connection). I also failed to accurately track the set of visited rooms to detect when all reachable neighbors had been explored, leading to an incorrect "DONE" command while unvisited rooms (like the one accessible from the east in the Playroom) remained. Next time, I will strictly ensure that for every move, I add the corresponding edge to the current room's direction list in the graph (e.g., if moving north, add the previous room to the "north" list of the current room). I will also maintain a precise list of visited rooms and only issue "DONE" after confirming that every available direction from the current room leads to a room already in my visited list.
